text: yearmonth.Date is TEXT 'YYYYMM' (e.g. '201202' = February 2012); the year is SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) and the month SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2).
Gas consumption is yearmonth.Consumption, one row per customer per month; a month's total consumption is SUM(Consumption) over all customers for that yearmonth.Date.
transactions_1k.Date is 'YYYY-MM-DD' and only covers 2012-08-23 to 2012-08-26; consumption by month or year comes from yearmonth, not from transactions.
transactions_1k.Price is the total paid for the transaction line, not a unit price; price per unit = transactions_1k.Price / transactions_1k.Amount.
customers.Currency is 'EUR' (euro) or 'CZK' (Czech koruna); 'paid in euro' means customers.Currency = 'EUR'.
gasstations.Country is a 3-letter code: 'CZE' = Czech Republic, 'SVK' = Slovakia.
gasstations.Segment (chain segment) values: 'Premium', 'Value for money', 'Discount', 'Noname', 'Other'; customers.Segment (client segment) is 'SME', 'LAM' or 'KAM'.
A product's name is products.Description (Czech labels such as 'Nafta', 'Natural'); join transactions_1k.ProductID = products.ProductID.
